hybridPreview.blendMode.workflowFirst.de: Lead with deterministic control, then let the swarm pressure-test the proposal.
hybridPreview.compare.balanced: For this preview, a lighter workflow-first spine with a swarm-heavy exploration stage gives the best balance.
hybridPreview.compare.balancedApproval: For this preview, workflow-first should lead the execution while the swarm feeds options into the validation gate.
hybridPreview.compare.description: Compare the two operating modes before choosing how much control versus exploration you want.
hybridPreview.compare.swarmFirst.recomme: Recommended for exploration, critique, and option generation before commit.
hybridPreview.compare.swarmFirst.title: Swarm-first
hybridPreview.compare.title: Workflow-first vs Swarm-first
hybridPreview.compare.workflowFirst.reco: Recommended when you want a stable spine but still need strong guardrails.
Recommended when the plan must be safe, approved, and easy to audit.
hybridPreview.compare.workflowFirst.stre: Stronger fit for approvals, publishing, and rollback-aware work.
Easier to audit and hand off across agents or humans.
hybridPreview.compare.workflowFirst.trad: Less room for open-ended exploration before the first commit.
Can feel slower when the task is still fuzzy.
hybridPreview.compare.swarmFirst.strengt: Surfaces edge cases and alternatives early.
Faster idea generation across multiple angles and perspectives.
Useful when the problem is fuzzy, broad, or heavily research-driven.
hybridPreview.compare.swarmFirst.tradeof: Needs a clearer validation gate to avoid drifting off brief.
Can produce more variation before the workflow reconciles the answer.
